name: Mooka (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Mooka city emblem in white: a stylised flower-like device with pointed petals enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Mooka, a city in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 December 1954.

features.role: Mooka city emblem — a stylised flower-like device with pointed petals enclosing a ring
